headline: Review of school goals, priorities, and strategic initiatives, led by Richard Lemons of Partners for Educational Leadership.
summary: The meeting will include a discussion and review of goals, priorities, and strategic initiatives. Richard Lemons of Partners for Educational Leadership will lead the review.
items: Discussion and review of goals, priorities, and strategic initiatives with Richard Lemons from Partners for Educational Leadership

HAMDEN BOARD OF EDUCATION ANNOUNCEMENT  
OF SPECIAL MEETING AND AGENDA  
FRIDAY, AUGUST 14, 2026 
 
The Board will hold a workshop at the Hamden Middle School Media Center on Friday, August 
14th from 10:00AM - 2:00PM.  
 
Topic: Board of Education workshop  
1. Call to order and roll call  
2. Information Items 
a. Discussion and Review of the Hamden Board of Education Goals, Priorities, and 
Strategic Initiatives with Richard Lemons from Partners for Educational 
Leadership 
 
3. Adjourn
